# The complete shell line this package hands to AWS-RunShellScript, one case
# per block. Each token of every Command was already validated by
# internal/ssh (argSpec/literalSpec/programSpec); the single quotes here are
# this package's own layer, not a substitute for that validation.
#
# Shape: [sudo -n] program args...  -- every token individually single-quoted
# and space-joined.

# plain
'uptime'

# sudo prefix
'sudo' '-n' 'uptime'

# UptimeCommand
'uptime'

# UnameCommand
'uname' '-a'

# HostnameCommand
'hostname'

# DateCommand
'date' '--iso-8601=seconds'

# OSReleaseCommand
'cat' '/etc/os-release'

# LSCPUCommand
'lscpu'

# LoadAvgCommand
'cat' '/proc/loadavg'

# FreeCommand
'free' '-b'

# MemInfoCommand
'cat' '/proc/meminfo'

# DFCommand
'df' '-PT'

# LSBLKCommand
'lsblk' '-o' 'NAME,TYPE,SIZE,FSTYPE,MOUNTPOINTS'

# FindMntCommand
'findmnt'

# IPAddrCommand
'ip' '-details' 'addr' 'show'

# IPRouteCommand
'ip' 'route' 'show'

# SocketStatsCommand
'ss' '-lntup'

# ResolvConfCommand
'cat' '/etc/resolv.conf'

# ProcessListCommand
'ps' '-eo' 'pid,ppid,user,state,%cpu,%mem,etime,nlwp,comm,args'

# ServiceStatusCommand
'systemctl' 'show' 'nginx.service' '--no-pager' '--property=Id,Description,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,ExecMainStatus,Result,TasksCurrent,TasksMax,NRestarts,MemoryCurrent'

# RPMQueryCommand
'rpm' '-q' 'libstdc++6'

# DpkgStatusCommand
'dpkg-query' '-s' 'libstdc++6'

# LogsCommand
'journalctl' '-u' 'nginx.service' '--since=-30m' '-n' '200' '--reverse' '--no-pager' '--output=short-iso'

# LogsRelativeWindowCommand
'journalctl' '-u' 'nginx.service' '--since=-150m' '--until=-2h' '-n' '100000' '--reverse' '--no-pager' '--output=short-iso'

# LogsSinceEpochCommand
'journalctl' '-u' 'nginx.service' '--since=@1795132800' '-n' '100000' '--reverse' '--no-pager' '--output=short-iso'

# LogsEpochWindowCommand
'journalctl' '-u' 'nginx.service' '--since=@1795132800' '--until=@1795219200' '-n' '200' '--reverse' '--no-pager' '--output=short-iso'

# KernelLogsCommand
'journalctl' '-k' '--since=-1h' '-n' '200' '--reverse' '--no-pager' '--output=short-iso'

# FilesCommands/check
'ls' '-d' '-n' '-b' '--time-style=full-iso' '/' '/var' '/var/log' '/var/log/nginx'

# FilesCommands/list
'ls' '-A' '-b' '-g' '-o' '--time-style=full-iso' '--block-size=1' '/var/log/nginx'
